title: RepoPact 3.1.4 paper submission and research closeout

preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: research/arxiv/ (main.tex, references.bib, figures/) is refreshed from an isolated source package against the exact 3.1.3-or-later release-candidate tree; research/arxiv/main.pdf is rebuilt and checked; all references/figures/claims are verified current. Submission-ready package prepared and reviewed, but the durable record continues to state ARXIV NOT SUBMITTED until AC-2.

arXiv submission itself is operator-gated: operator confirms/creates an arXiv account, obtains cs.SE endorsement if required for a first submission, gives final approval of the exact paper text, and personally submits. This criterion cannot be satisfied by an agent; it is satisfied only by a real arXiv URL recorded as evidence.

WI063 ROG-028: Workbench graph behavior is usable across wide and compact form factors without essential operations depending on hover/right-click; durable graph semantics remain path-normalized and cross-platform portable; mobile capability handling composes with WI061 rather than assuming unrestricted filesystem/system-Git access.

WI063 ROG-034: R1 (the ROG-based orientation approach) is evaluated against the already-registered S8 correctness and orientation-cost measures (governance/violation recovery, false-clean rate, authority-state error, orientation time, tokens, tool calls, file reads, repository-wide grep/search operations, bytes read, human interventions). Reduced search with degraded correctness is not accepted as a win.

WI063 ROG-038: closeout evidence enumerates the exact durable graph format, paths, schema, fingerprint, node/edge classes, language/relation coverage, query surface, cache behavior, Workbench surface, unsupported capabilities, parser/resource limits, cross-platform normalization, performance/storage results, security/adversarial tests, and remaining future work, with links to executable evidence rather than prose-only claims. WI063 moves to work/completed/ once AC-3/AC-4/AC-5 (ROG-028/034/038) are all satisfied.

WI066's 'Superseded by 3.1.1 and 3.1.2' framing is extended to note 3.1.3 (installers) and 3.1.4 (this item) without rewriting its historical AC-9/AC-10/AC-11 pending states or any dated evidence. WI021 (public launch) AC-1 is reconciled if the paper/installer releases now provide the durable proof it was waiting on; AC-2 (arXiv) is reconciled from this item's AC-2; AC-4 (Show HN) remains explicitly operator-gated and is not marked satisfied by this item.

RepoPact 3.1.4 is published through the normal governed release path if any package/runtime-affecting source changed to close ROG-028 (VERSION bump, decision record, build/verify/tag/publish, clean install); if ROG-028/034/038 closure required no package/runtime source change, no new package version is cut and this is recorded explicitly rather than assumed.
